product.title: Grand Canyon Tour from Tusayan

description.text: This six-hour Tusayan departure covers the essential South Rim in a single comfortable bus tour. Multiple viewpoint stops, time at Grand Canyon Village, and included park entrance fees make it a straightforward full-morning or afternoon introduction to the canyon.
